sub.scene: A shopper holds a shirt up to a mirror in a bright clothing shop with racks of colourful clothes.
A person pushes a trolley down a supermarket aisle lined with shelves of fruit, vegetables and bread.
A customer and a smiling seller talk over a pile of fruit at a busy outdoor market stall.
A cashier hands a receipt to a customer paying with a card at a checkout with a sale sign.
A courier hands a parcel to a smiling person at their front door while a phone shows a shopping app.
A customer shows a broken item and a receipt to a shop assistant at a service desk.

words.ex: This shirt is too small for me.
words.tip: Áo sơ mi: "sơ mi" nghe gần giống "shirt".

words.ex: She bought a blue dress for the party.
words.tip: Váy liền: "dress up" là ăn diện.

words.ex: These jeans fit me perfectly.
words.tip: Quần bò luôn ở số nhiều: a pair of jeans.

words.ex: Can I try this jacket on?

words.def: things you wear on your feet when you go outside
words.ex: I need new shoes for work.
words.tip: Giày: luôn đếm theo đôi, a pair of shoes.

words.ex: What size do you wear?
words.tip: Cỡ áo: S, M, L đều là size.

words.ex: Do you have this in a small?
I usually wear a large.

words.def: red, blue or green, for example
words.ex: Do you have it in another colour?
May I try these shoes on?

words.def: a small room in a shop where you try on clothes
words.ex: The fitting room is at the back.
These trousers do not fit me.
words.tip: Fit = vừa người; khác "suit" là hợp phong cách.

words.ex: The shirt is a bit tight around the arms.
I prefer loose trousers in summer.
words.tip: Rộng thùng thình, trái nghĩa với tight.

words.ex: The sleeve is too long for my arm.
words.tip: Tay áo: "slee-v" tay dài tay ngắn.

words.def: the part of a shirt or coat that goes around your neck
words.ex: The collar on this shirt is stained.
words.tip: Cổ áo: liên tưởng "cô-la" cổ áo.

words.ex: I love the style of this coat.

words.def: popular and modern at a particular time
words.ex: Those trainers look very fashionable.
This T-shirt is made of cotton.
words.tip: Vải cotton: loại vải thoáng mát quen thuộc.

words.ex: What material is this jacket made of?
words.tip: Chất liệu vải: material = nguyên liệu.

words.ex: I bought a wool scarf for winter.

words.def: looking fashionable and attractive
words.ex: He always wears stylish clothes.

words.vi: việc sửa quần áo; sự thay đổi
words.def: a small change made to clothes so they fit better
words.ex: The suit needs a small alteration at the waist.
words.tip: Sửa quần áo cho vừa: alter = thay đổi.

words.ex: I buy fruit at the supermarket on Sundays.
We shop for food every weekend.
words.tip: Shop vừa là cửa hàng vừa là đi mua sắm.

words.ex: Put the milk in the basket.
words.tip: Giỏ xách tay trong siêu thị.

words.def: a metal cart you push around a shop
words.ex: The trolley has a broken wheel.
words.tip: Xe đẩy hàng; Mỹ gọi là "cart".

words.ex: The rice is in aisle four.
words.tip: Lối đi giữa các kệ: "aisle" đọc "ai-ồ", chữ s câm.

words.ex: The milk is on the top shelf.
words.tip: Kệ hàng: số nhiều là shelves.

words.ex: I need a loaf of bread for breakfast.
We ran out of milk this morning.
words.tip: Sữa: đếm bằng carton hay bottle.

words.def: plants such as carrots or cabbage that you eat
words.ex: I buy fresh vegetables every few days.
Do you sell fresh fruit here?
words.tip: Trái cây: không thêm s khi nói chung.

words.ex: I do not eat much meat.
Is this fish fresh today?

words.def: kept at a very low temperature so it is hard
words.ex: I keep frozen peas in the freezer.
Can I have a packet of rice?
words.tip: Gói nhỏ; "package" thường là kiện hàng.

words.ex: I bought a bottle of water.
I forgot one ingredient for the soup.
The assistant will weigh the apples for you.
Check the expiry date before you buy.
words.tip: Hạn sử dụng: expire = hết hạn.

words.ex: She only buys organic vegetables.
I used the self-checkout to save time.
words.tip: Quầy tự thanh toán: self + checkout.

words.ex: Perishable goods must go in the fridge quickly.
There is a busy market near my house.
She runs a fruit stall in the market.
What is the price of this bag?
Vegetables are cheap at the market.
This watch is too expensive for me.

words.def: used to ask the price of something
words.ex: How much are these oranges?
words.tip: Cụm hỏi giá số 1: How much...?

words.def: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams
words.ex: Two kilos of rice, please.
You can bargain at the street market.
words.tip: Mặc cả: gần giống "ba-gần" trả giá.

words.ex: She haggled over the price of the scarf.
words.tip: Cò kè giá: đồng nghĩa bargain, hơi thân mật.

words.ex: I can offer you ten dollars for it.

words.def: the lowest price a seller will accept
words.ex: Is that your last price?
words.tip: Giá cuối: dùng khi chốt mặc cả.

words.def: more than is needed or acceptable
words.ex: Fifty is too much for this bag.
words.tip: Quá nhiều/quá đắt khi nói về giá.

words.def: to make something less in amount or price
words.ex: Could you lower the price a little?
The seller gave me a small discount.
The seller greeted every customer with a smile.
The vendor sells fresh flowers every morning.

words.def: fruit and vegetables that have just been picked
words.ex: The market is famous for its fresh produce.

words.def: full of people
words.ex: The market is very crowded on Saturday.
This coat is not worth that much.
Three for ten dollars is a good deal.
I will pay in cash at the stall.
Keep the change, please.

words.def: made by a person, not by a machine
words.ex: These handmade bags are very popular.
I bought a small souvenir for my mother.

words.def: something that costs far more than it is worth
words.ex: Forty dollars for that is a total rip-off.
words.tip: Cắt cổ/chặt chém: rip = xé toạc.

words.ex: Students get a ten percent discount.
The shoes are on sale this week.
words.tip: Đợt giảm giá: on sale = đang giảm.

words.ex: Do you take cash or card?
Can I pay by card?

words.def: a plastic card you use to buy now and pay later
words.ex: Do you accept credit cards?
words.tip: Thẻ tín dụng: credit = tín dụng.

words.ex: Please keep your receipt.
words.tip: Hóa đơn nhận: p câm, đọc "ri-síc".

words.ex: Could we have the bill, please?
words.tip: Hóa đơn phải trả; Mỹ hay dùng "check".

words.ex: What is the total, please?
The cashier scanned my items.
There is a long queue at the checkout.
We waited in a long queue to pay.
How much does this phone cost?
I cannot afford a new laptop this year.
words.tip: Đủ khả năng mua: nhớ "can't afford".

words.ex: I have a small budget for gifts.
I spend too much money on clothes.
I saved twenty dollars with this coupon.
I have a coupon for ten percent off.
She gave me a gift voucher for my birthday.

words.def: a lower price for a short time
words.ex: There is a special offer on rice this week.
I asked the shop for a refund.

words.def: paying by touching a card or phone on a machine
words.ex: You can pay contactless with your phone.
I paid for the sofa in monthly instalments.
words.tip: Trả góp từng kỳ: Mỹ viết installment.

words.ex: The shop overcharged me for the milk.
I often buy books online.
The website is easy to use.

words.def: a program you use on a phone
words.ex: I use an app to order food.
I ordered a pair of shoes yesterday.
Delivery takes two or three days.
They deliver to your door for free.
My parcel arrived this morning.
Please check your delivery address.
words.tip: Địa chỉ: hai chữ d, hai chữ s.

words.def: click to put an item in your online basket
words.ex: Click add to cart to save the item.
words.tip: Thêm vào giỏ: hay thấy trên web.

words.ex: I forgot my password for the shop account.
I created an account to track my order.

words.def: the process or cost of sending goods to a buyer
words.ex: Shipping is free for orders over fifty dollars.
You can track your parcel on the app.
The package should arrive on Friday.
The courier left the parcel at my door.
Is this size still in stock?
Sorry, that colour is out of stock.
words.tip: Hết hàng: ngược với in stock.

words.ex: I read the reviews before I bought it.

words.def: a score that shows how good something is
words.ex: This seller has a high rating.
words.tip: Điểm đánh giá: rate = chấm điểm.

words.ex: Your payment was successful.
You will get an email to confirm your order.
The courier asked for my signature.
words.tip: Chữ ký nhận hàng: sign + ature.

words.ex: I want to return this jacket.
Can I exchange this for a bigger size?

words.def: damaged and not working
words.ex: The screen of my phone is broken.
You sent me the wrong size.
I have a problem with my order.
I wrote to the shop to complain.
I made a complaint about the late delivery.

words.def: harmed so that it is no longer perfect
words.ex: The box arrived damaged.
The kettle I bought is faulty.

words.def: not in the place where it should be
words.ex: One item was missing from my parcel.
What is your return policy?
The laptop has a two-year warranty.
The phone comes with a one-year guarantee.
Could I speak to the manager, please?

words.def: to say sorry for a mistake
words.ex: The shop apologised for the mistake.
There was a mistake on my bill.
They will replace the broken cup for free.
I asked for a replacement.
The company will reimburse you for the cost.

words.def: not happy with something
words.ex: I am dissatisfied with the service.
They offered me compensation for the delay.
You need proof of purchase to return it.
words.tip: Chứng từ mua hàng: proof + purchase.

words.def: pleased because you got what you wanted
words.ex: I am very satisfied with this product.

phrases.vi: Gạo ở đâu vậy bạn?

phrases.en: Is this fresh?
phrases.vi: Cái này có tươi không?

phrases.en: Could I have a bag, please?
phrases.vi: Cho tôi xin một cái túi nhé?

phrases.en: If I buy three, can I get a discount?
phrases.vi: Nếu mua ba cái thì được giảm giá không?

phrases.en: Can I pay by card?
phrases.vi: Tôi trả bằng thẻ được không?

phrases.en: Do you take cash?
phrases.vi: Bạn có nhận tiền mặt không?

phrases.en: Could I have a receipt, please?
phrases.vi: Cho tôi xin hóa đơn nhé?

phrases.en: Is there a sale on at the moment?
phrases.vi: Hiện giờ có đợt giảm giá nào không?

phrases.en: Keep the change.
phrases.vi: Bạn cứ giữ tiền thối.

phrases.en: Is this item in stock?
phrases.vi: Mặt hàng này còn hàng không?

phrases.en: When will my order arrive?
phrases.vi: Khi nào đơn hàng của tôi sẽ đến?

phrases.en: Is shipping free?
phrases.vi: Phí vận chuyển có miễn phí không?

phrases.en: Where is my parcel? Can I track it?
phrases.vi: Bưu kiện của tôi đâu rồi? Tôi theo dõi được không?

phrases.en: Can I exchange it for a different size?

phrases.en: I would like a refund, please.
phrases.vi: Tôi muốn được hoàn tiền.

phrases.en: It arrived damaged.
phrases.vi: Hàng đến nơi đã bị hư hại.

phrases.en: I have the receipt here.
phrases.vi: Tôi có hóa đơn đây.

phrases.vi: Chính sách đổi trả của bạn thế nào?

phrases.en: Could I speak to the manager, please?

lines: Can I try this jacket on?
Tôi mặc thử áo khoác này được không?
Of course. The fitting room is over there.
Dĩ nhiên rồi. Phòng thử đồ ở đằng kia.
It is a bit tight. Do you have a larger size?
Hơi chật. Bạn có cỡ lớn hơn không?
Do you have this shirt in blue?
Áo này có màu xanh dương không?
Let me check. What size do you wear?
Để tôi xem. Bạn mặc cỡ nào?
Yes, we have one. It is cotton.
Có, còn một cái. Vải cotton đấy.
Excuse me, where is the milk?
Xin lỗi, sữa ở đâu vậy?
It is in aisle three, on the top shelf.
Ở lối đi số ba, trên kệ trên cùng.
Cá này hôm nay có tươi không?
Yes, it came in this morning.
Great. I will take half a kilo.
Chiếc khăn này giá bao nhiêu?
That is too much. Can you lower the price?
Đắt quá. Bạn bớt được không?
Fifteen. That is my last price.
Mười lăm. Đó là giá cuối của tôi.
I will take three oranges and two apples.
Cho tôi ba quả cam và hai quả táo.
Here you are. Keep the change.
Của bạn đây. Bạn giữ tiền thối nhé.
That will be forty dollars, please.
Tổng cộng bốn mươi đô ạ.
Tôi trả bằng thẻ được không?
Of course. Would you like a receipt?
Được chứ. Bạn có cần hóa đơn không?
Is there a discount for students?
Có giảm giá cho sinh viên không?
Yes, ten percent with a student card.
Có, giảm mười phần trăm với thẻ sinh viên.
My order has not arrived yet.
Đơn hàng của tôi vẫn chưa đến.
Let me check. Can I have your order number?
Để tôi kiểm tra. Cho tôi mã đơn hàng nhé?
Phí vận chuyển có miễn phí không?
Yes, for orders over fifty dollars.
Có, cho đơn trên năm mươi đô.
I would like to return this kettle.
Tôi muốn trả lại cái ấm này.
It is faulty. It does not turn on.
Nó bị lỗi. Không bật lên được.
I can give you a refund. Do you have the receipt?
Tôi hoàn tiền cho bạn được. Bạn có hóa đơn không?
I want to make a complaint about my order.
Tôi muốn khiếu nại về đơn hàng của mình.
I am sorry to hear that. What happened?
Tôi rất tiếc. Có chuyện gì vậy?
One item was missing and the box was damaged.
Thiếu một món và hộp bị hư hại.
We will send a replacement today.
Hôm nay chúng tôi sẽ gửi hàng thay thế.
